title: llm-cli node inventory
description: Private per-operator inventory read by `llm-cli nodes` and `llm-cli push`. Lives at ~/.config/vigyan/nodes.json (mode 600) and is never committed. It names SSH targets only: keys and secrets stay in the operator's existing SSH setup and are never copied.

name.description: Node name; matched against the short hostname to find this node's own entry.

ssh.description: SSH target as you would type it (alias from ~/.ssh/config, host, or user@host). `local` means this machine.

user.description: Login user on the node (informational; the SSH target decides).

os.description: windows-git-bash: commands are run through Git Bash (the Windows OpenSSH server starts cmd.exe).

role.description: dev: agent CLIs, front doors, interop, shared memory, MOTD with CLI versions. server: no agent CLIs; telemetry and model services, MOTD with service health.

clis.description: Optional: limit the agent CLIs a dev node manages. Omit for the role default.

bash.description: windows-git-bash only: path to Git Bash's bash.exe when not in the default location.
